description: The school mailbox's eligible accounts (owner, 2026-11-27; docs/wiki/mail-client-transport.md#eligibility). An account may use the mail client when MiConnect hands Canari its SCHOOL address (claim `school_mail`, CAS accounts only) and that address's domain is EXACTLY one of these keys (lowercase, no subdomain); the value is the class Canari stores in its place (`users.mailClass`), never the address. Held equal by a test on each side that names them: the MiConnect mapping (infrastructure/authentik/blueprints/10-mappings.yaml, `miconnect-claim-school-mail`), core-service (apps/core-service/src/users/mail-class.ts), the relay (apps/chat-gateway/src/mail_relay.rs, `MAIL_CLASSES`) and the client (frontend/src/lib/mail/eligibility.ts).
